description: fyyd, the open podcast directory — search individual podcast episodes, matching the term against episode titles and show-note descriptions, optionally filtered by language. Returns each episode's fyyd id, title, description, publication date, duration, audio enclosure URL and its parent podcast id. Answers which podcast episode covered a subject and where to listen to it.
name: search_episodes
